name: Order Flow Bubbles
tags: order flow bubbles canvas notional aggressor buy sell stream
note: Canvas stream where every print becomes a bubble sized by the square root of notional and drifting up the tape, so a block trade is visible instantly.

name: Liquidity Heat Map
note: Resting book depth as a 24x10 heat grid scrolling right to left. Ask-side cells run green, bid-side red, and the mid row keeps a bright rail so the drift is readable. The DEPTH button cycles the intensity gain 1x/2x/4x and has a visible focus ring.

name: Tick Tape Canvas
note: A DPR-aware canvas painting the last 90 prints: price polyline plus a dot per trade sized by quantity and coloured by aggressor, with a ring around anything over 12 lots. The header price flashes up/down on each tick and buy/sell running totals update beneath.
html:
NQZ5 TICK TAPE 20,614.25 ▲ +0.75
▲ buys 312 ▼ sells 287 last 90 prints

name: Trade Size Scatter
note: Every print is an SVG bubble: x is arrival order, y is price, radius is sqrt of size, fill is aggressor side. Prints over 150 lots get a pulsing ring. The whole point layer translates left on a spring transition as new dots pop in, and the biggest print of the window is called out.
html:
CLZ5 PRINT SIZE SCATTER max 0
10 100 500 ▲ lift▼ hit

name: VWAP Deviation Bands
note: Price against session VWAP with rolling +/-1 and +/-2 sigma envelopes. Bands rise into place on mount while the price path draws itself with a dash-offset sweep; the end marker springs along and the badge reports the live deviation in sigma with a sign and arrow.
html:
AAPL VWAP DEVIATION ▲ +0.00σ
— vwap 231.48±1σ±2σ231.92

name: Cumulative Delta
note: Per-bar buy-minus-sell delta as a signed histogram around a zero rail, with the cumulative delta line drawn over it in SVG. Bars stagger in on mount, shift left on each new bar, and the headline CVD figure counts to its new value with an eased tween.
html:
MESZ5 CUMULATIVE DELTA ▲+0
▲ buy delta▼ sell delta— cvd

name: Large Print Detector
note: A print feed that flags anything at or above the chosen threshold: block rows arrive with a ripple ring, a gold BLOCK tag and a size in bold, while ordinary prints stay dim. The threshold button cycles 250/500/1000 shares and re-evaluates the visible rows.
html:
SPY LARGE PRINT DETECTOR
